unit: successful uninterrupted walk, dock, contact-qualified lift and released stable placement per allocated episode
hidden_resets: Fresh OS-entropy seeded 64-bit keys allocated before each panel. Each shadow has a distinct reset.

panels.purpose: Measure the published reference denominator using the bootstrap oracle arm. Retain the untouched arm.
Independently sample the reference spread. Retain all three completed panels.
Measure independent untouched and oracle runs after calibration with the same frozen inputs.

full_credit_count: max(1, minimum strict_mobile_placements among N0,N1,N2,N3 minus one placement)
required: N0 and the spread panels must contain full-roster finite physical measurements with passing observation-sensitivity controls. Preserve all completed measurements and separately identify infrastructure failures. N0 must have at least one strict placement.
reward: min(1, min(1.5, raw/anchor_value)/full_at) when observation controls pass; otherwise zero. Raw strict count and denominator remain available.
cost_and_quality: Applied native rows and individual integer codes, changed coordinates and absolute bin jumps, simulated time, pelvis travel/acceleration and decoder target-step RMS are reported alongside the physical outcome.
